heading: 4.6 Objective Six: direct hospital cost implications
objective: To estimate the direct hospital cost implications of using combined MAS and hs-CRP in evaluating suspected acute appendicitis.
methods: The only recorded monetary variable was total hospital cost in Nigerian naira (NGN). All 85 records were valid and none was zero. Costs are described by their total, mean, SD, median, quartiles and range. Admission and diagnostic timing are resource context, not monetary components. The dataset has no separate pathway expenditure or itemised quantities and unit prices for MAS and hs-CRP versus MAS or hs-CRP. No incremental cost, saving, cost-effectiveness ratio or hypothesis test was manufactured.
finalParagraph: Recorded hospital expenditure can be described reliably, but the approved incremental-cost question cannot be answered from total cost alone. Strategy-specific resource use and cost data are required before a financial advantage can be attributed to either combined rule.
